title: AdaExplore: Failure-Driven Adaptation and Diversity-Preserving Search for Efficient Kernel Generation

mechanism.populationDetail: Each kernel candidate is a node in an explicit search tree; UCT selects nodes for expansion.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The tree search and representative-kernel context do not establish a distinct elite archive.
mechanism.generationDetail: Tree expansion alternates between localized patch refinement and large structural regeneration.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Failure-derived natural-language constraints are clustered and promoted into cross-task memory; diversity is maintained over tree search.

provenance.sourcePdf: additional_papers/202604/AdaExplore Failure-Driven Adaptation and Diversity-Preserving Search for Efficient Kernel Generation.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Parent-selection rule is mapped to UCT-guided tree-branch selection; representative kernels are references, not additional parents.
